_note: A pension paid periodically by a former employer, and salary: "any annuity or pension" (S2 s.16(b), pp.37–38; 1961 s.17(1)(ii)), so the standard deduction reaches it; its lump-sum commutation is COMMUTED_PENSION. Family pension is not this: it is income of the family member, under other sources. Salary bases (W-242 C1a, owner ruling D-514): the accommodation salary only — Rules 2026 r.15(8)(k) takes "any monetary payment, by whatever name called, from one or more employers" and excludes in (vi) only "commutation of pension" among lump sums on leaving; it stands where BONUS stands. In none of the others: the HRA, gratuity, pension-scheme and provident-fund bases are "dearness allowance, if the terms of employment so provide, but … all other allowances and perquisites" excluded, and the entertainment base "exclusive of any allowance, benefit or other perquisite"; none names a pension, and as for bonus (D-094) the words are read as not reaching it. A reading, not a quoted exclusion. CASH: paid in money (DR 05 M2).
